name: agent-runtime
description: The agentic-worker execution runtime (ADR-0014): subscribes to agent.run.requested, reads the run's resolved definition from the Core internal API, runs the turn loop against OpenRouter, and posts the outcome back so Core emits agent.run.completed. Owns no data — every piece of run state lives in Core (ADR-0002), reached over the IAM-signed internal API (ADR-0009). First-party and template-owned: distributed by `biffo core upgrade`, not the plugin registry.
author: Biffo Team

event_subscriptions.description: The execution trigger. Core emits this when a run record is created (by the orchestrator's `agent` action, ADR-0014 §4 — invocation is EventBridge and only EventBridge). The event carries a reference, never the payload, so the runtime fetches the run through the internal API before executing it (§5).

A schedule tick from this plugin's own EventBridge rule (terraform/), not a Core event — hence the distinct source. It carries no payload; the runtime simply asks Core to fail runs a dead invocation left in `running`, so anything waiting on agent.run.completed is released rather than waiting for ever (ADR-0014 §5, issue #402).
